games.note: Both 6-1. Arizona just cracked my top 25 and Texas Tech just fell out of it. One of them swaps places again by Sunday.
Wisconsin earned its spot by beating USC. A road trip to Kinnick is a much harder way to keep it.
Auburn is hanging onto the last spot in my poll at 4-3. Ole Miss is trying to stop a slide after losing in Austin.
Minnesota is coming off a win over Iowa and sits just outside my poll. Indiana at home is the chance to make that win look like more than a one-off.
A 6-1 Northwestern team nobody saw coming visits a 4-3 Oregon team nobody expected to be here. Both are on the outside looking in.
